title: AV and entertainment system usability
summary: Feedback centers on AV and entertainment systems that are often described as hard to operate or not functioning correctly, with one request for added rear-seat meeting app capability.

positive.summary: One positive review asks for a Microsoft Teams app in the rear entertainment system to support in-car meetings.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the AV or entertainment system as overly complex, poorly controlled, unusable, or failing to operate correctly.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention components not operating, but the fragments do not provide enough context to classify the sentiment more specifically.

limitations: The topic includes both infotainment usability comments and at least one radar sensor operation comment, so the cluster is not fully coherent.
Several fragments are very short and lack context, which limits precise interpretation.
The examples are a stratified sample and are not representative estimates of the broader owner population.
